source.rationale: The has-incoming set is built from rows that may be null, may have no title, and may have no fields at all. Each is skipped in turn; only the row that actually names SRTB contributes. If any of those guards inverts, the code set fills with junk and every sibling reads 'no incoming' — a confident wrong answer about stock the customer could have had.
